hints: Browns has 27 employees. The median is the (27 + 1)/2 = 14th value in order.
Locate the 14th value from the diagram for Browns: 32400 dollars.
The lower quartile is the 7th value (31300 dollars) and the upper quartile is the 21st value (33500 dollars).
walkthrough:
Find the position of the median for $n = 27$ employees at Browns:
$$\text{Position of median} = \frac{27 + 1}{2} = 14\text{th value}$$
$$\text{Median} = 32400\text{ dollars}$$

Find the lower quartile ($Q_1$, 7th value) and upper quartile ($Q_3$, 21st value):
$$Q_1 = 31300\text{ dollars}, \quad Q_3 = 33500\text{ dollars}$$

Compute the interquartile range:
$$\mathrm{IQR} = Q_3 - Q_1 = 33500 - 31300 = 2200\text{ dollars}$$
teacher_walkthrough:
Step 1: Identify the median position for Browns ($n = 27$):
$$\text{Median position} = \frac{n + 1}{2} = \frac{27 + 1}{2} = 14$$
Counting 14 leaves into the Browns distribution gives $32400$ dollars.

Step 2: Find the lower quartile $Q_1$ and upper quartile $Q_3$:
- Lower quartile position: $\frac{27 + 1}{4} = 7$th value $\implies Q_1 = 31300$ dollars.
- Upper quartile position: $3 \times 7 = 21$st value $\implies Q_3 = 33500$ dollars.

Step 3: Calculate the interquartile range:
$$\mathrm{IQR} = Q_3 - Q_1 = 33500 - 31300 = 2200\text{ dollars}$$

skill_tags: Calculating a Mean from Raw Data

hints: Combine the two companies (27 employees each, so total n = 54). Work in thousands of dollars: sum(x) = 878.3 + 896.5 = 1774.8.
Calculate the overall mean: 1774.8 / 54 = 32.8667 thousand dollars, which equals 32900 dollars (3 s.f.).
Calculate variance: (58431.72 / 54) - (32.8667)^2 = 1082.0689 - 1080.2178 = 1.8511. Take the square root: sqrt(1.8511) = 1.3605 thousand dollars = 1360 dollars.
walkthrough:
Combine the sample sums for all $n = 54$ employees (working in thousands of dollars):
$$\sum x = 878.3 + 896.5 = 1774.8$$
$$\text{Mean } \bar{x} = \frac{1774.8}{54} \approx 32.8667\text{ thousand dollars} \implies 32900\text{ dollars (3 s.f.)}$$

Combine the sum of squares $\sum x^2$:
$$\sum x^2 = 28616.09 + 29815.63 = 58431.72$$

Compute the combined variance and standard deviation:
$$\sigma^2 = \frac{58431.72}{54} - \left(\frac{1774.8}{54}\right)^2 = 1082.0689 - 1080.2178 = 1.8511$$
$$\sigma = \sqrt{1.8511} \approx 1.36055\text{ thousand dollars} \implies 1360\text{ dollars}$$
teacher_walkthrough:
Step 1: Combine the sample data for both companies ($n_1 = 27, n_2 = 27 \implies n = 54$):
Working in thousands of dollars:
$$\sum x = \sum x_1 + \sum x_2 = 878.3 + 896.5 = 1774.8$$
$$\bar{x} = \frac{\sum x}{n} = \frac{1774.8}{54} = 32.86667\dots$$
In dollars: $32866.67$ dollars $\approx 32900$ dollars (3 s.f.).

Step 2: Combine the sum of squares:
$$\sum x^2 = 28616.09 + 29815.63 = 58431.72$$

Step 4: Calculate the standard deviation:
$$\sigma = \sqrt{1.851111} \approx 1.360555\text{ thousand dollars}$$
Multiplying by 1000 to convert to dollars:
$$\sigma \approx 1360\text{ dollars}$$
